ApplicationInsights.//: Connection string is empty by default — populated via env var APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING in deployed environments. Leave empty in local dev to disable telemetry; the /diag page surfaces App Insights config state via /api/diag/telemetry.

AI.//: Endpoint + deployments come from Key Vault (kv-poshared, PoMiniGames--AI--*) in deployed environments. ValidateDeploymentsOnStartup lists the account's deployments and fails Production startup on a name that is not there — the check that would have caught the gpt-4o-mini/gpt-4o phantoms before players did.
AI.//Deployments: Per-game (and per-task, 'game.task') deployment routing. These are LOCAL FALLBACKS only — the Key Vault secret PoMiniGames--AI--Deployments wins when present (flat form fills gaps, never overwrites). Task routing: joker.rating scores three numbers (Phi-4-mini-instruct is the right size and ~10x cheaper than a gpt-5 deployment); joker.rewrite stays on the default because creative quality matters there. couplequiz.similarity is the chat fallback for answer scoring — cheap model by design.

TokenBudget.//: Per-identity daily token ceiling across the whole AI surface. The 'infer' rate limit shapes burst (10 req/s) but bounds no spend at all: one tab left open is ~36k calls/hour against a metered deployment.

Inference.//UseCloudFallback: Was false, which meant a deployed PoSurvive never mapped POST /api/infer at all and every player fell through to a multi-hundred-MB in-browser model download. On is now the default; availability is still gated by whether PoMiniGames:AI is actually configured (AIFoundryOptions.IsConfigured), and /api/infer/status reports the truth either way.
Inference.//ServerBudgetMs: Ceiling on one relay call including retries. Must stay below the client's per-agent budget (client appsettings Inference:InferenceTimeoutMs, 15000): a measured call once ran 51.6s — three 15s SDK attempts — long after the browser had abandoned it.
Inference.//RemoteModelOptions: Server-side allowlist of ids a client may name, mapped to real deployments. gpt-4o-mini/gpt-4o were listed here and in PoMiniGames:AI:Deployments but do not exist on the shared account (verified 2026-07-29: gpt-5.4-nano, gpt-5-nano, gpt-5.4-mini, Phi-4-mini-instruct, Phi-4) — every call 404'd DeploymentNotFound or silently fell back to the Key Vault default.

PoVoxelStrike.//: Startup GLB → voxel ingestion. Paths resolve against the content root when relative. On App Service (WEBSITE_RUN_FROM_PACKAGE=1, read-only package mount) ConvertedPath must be overridden to a writable absolute path under %HOME%\data.
